description: This file defines the ImageDownloader class, which handles asynchronous downloading and caching of images from the internet for use in Android ImageView widgets.

classes.name: ImageDownloader
classes.description: A helper class for downloading images asynchronously with internal caching for use in Android applications.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous download of an image from a URL and binds it to an ImageView.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Overloaded method that allows specifying a cookie header during download.

classes.name: BitmapDownloaderTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass that performs the image download in the background.

classes.name: DownloadedDrawable
classes.description: A Drawable that associates a download task with an ImageView to manage ongoing downloads.

methods.name: getBitmapFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached bitmap from hard or soft cache.

methods.name: resetPurgeTimer
methods.description: Resets the inactivity timer that clears the cache.

methods.name: cancelPotentialDownload
methods.description: Cancels ongoing download if the URL differs.

methods.name: getBitmapDownloaderTask
methods.description: Retrieves the download task associated with an ImageView.
